title: Favoritism dishonors the poor and convicts the partial as transgressors
speaker: James
topic: The Little Ones and the Poor
note: Extend A028 (2:1–5) through the rebuke (2:6–7) and the verdict on favoritism (2:9); 2:8 is A011, 2:10–12 A089.

title: Show your faith by works; even the demons believe and shudder
speaker: James
note: Extend AUD-63-2-14 (2:14–17) to 2:14–20: the objector's reply and 'faith apart from works is idle' lead into A070 (2:21).

title: God yearns jealously for the spirit He made dwell in us
speaker: James, citing Scripture
note: Scriptural motive for 4:4's warning against friendship with the world; extend AUD-63-4-4 to 4:4–5 (A116 begins at 4:6).

title: Woe to the rich who hoard, withhold wages and condemn the righteous
speaker: James
note: Extend A045 to 5:1–6 and retype it Wisdom: a woe whose 5:1 summons the rich to weep and howl.

title: Rejoice amid trials that test faith as fire tests gold
speaker: Peter
recipient: the chosen resident aliens of the dispersion
note: Same teaching as James 1:2–4 (A055), stated within the opening blessing (1:3–12); the rest of 1:1–12 is greeting, praise and doctrine.

title: Christ suffered once, the righteous for the unrighteous, as our pattern
speaker: Peter
recipient: the chosen resident aliens of the dispersion
note: 'For Christ also suffered' grounds 3:17's maxim on suffering for doing good, as Christ's example does at 2:21 (A052).

title: God's power and promises ground the call to add virtue
speaker: Peter
recipient: those who received a faith of equal honor
note: 1:5 'for this very reason' rests on the 'since' clause of 1:3–4; extend AUD-65-1-5 to 1:3–11. Doctrinal ground, so low.

title: Peter resolves to keep reminding them so they remember after his death
speaker: Peter
recipient: those who received a faith of equal honor
note: 'Remind you of these things' refers to 1:5–11; extend AUD-65-1-5 to 1:5–15. Autobiographical; cf. the same reminding in AUD-65-3-1 (3:1–2).

title: False teachers will arise among you and exploit you through greed
speaker: Peter
recipient: those who received a faith of equal honor
note: Heads the chapter's warning; cf. Matthew 7:15 (K085), Jude 1:4 (AUD-69-1-3). The catalogue itemizes such apostolic warnings separately (A061, A062).

title: God spared neither sinning angels nor the ancient world, but kept Noah
speaker: Peter
recipient: those who received a faith of equal honor
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: One conditional sentence runs 2:4–10a ('If God did not spare… then the Lord knows'); extend A096 (2:6–9) to 2:4–10a.

title: False teachers slander glorious beings and follow Balaam's path of greed
speaker: Peter
recipient: those who received a faith of equal honor
note: Portrait of the false teachers (2:10b–16); angels do not slander (2:11). Cf. Jude 1:8–11 (AUD-69-1-3 link, A095); AUD-65-2-17 begins at 2:17.

title: The scoffers ignore that God's word flooded the world and reserves fire
speaker: Peter
recipient: the beloved readers of his second letter
note: Peter's answer to the scoffers quoted in 3:4; extend AUD-65-3-1 (3:1–4) to 3:1–7, before A120 (3:8).

title: Await the promised new heavens and earth where righteousness dwells
speaker: Peter
recipient: the beloved readers of his second letter
note: Completes the 'waiting' of 3:12 and grounds 3:14 ('as you await these things'); extend A059 (3:10–12) to 3:10–13.

title: Do not sin; if anyone sins, Christ is our Advocate
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: 'I write these things so that you may not sin' completes 1:5–10's teaching on sin and confession; extend AUD-66-1-5 to 1:5–2:2.

title: Recognize the antichrists who deny the Son and went out from us
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: 2:24 'As for you' answers 2:18–23, and 2:26 refers back; extend AUD-66-2-24 to 2:18–28. 2:22–23 state A061's confession test.

title: Everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: Same test as 3:7 and 3:10 in AUD-66-3-7: practicing righteousness shows birth from God.

title: Sin is lawlessness; whoever abides in Him does not sin
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: 3:4–6 open the contrast of practicing sin and righteousness that 3:7–10 complete; extend AUD-66-3-7 to 3:4–10.

title: Do not be surprised if the world hates you
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: Direct prohibition between A094 (3:11–12) and A014 (3:15); cf. John 15:18–19 and 1 Peter 4:12 (A054).

title: Love of the brothers shows passage from death into life
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: 'The one who does not love abides in death' is completed by 3:15; extend A014 to 3:14–15.

title: Keep His commandments and have confidence before God in prayer
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: Assurance of the heart, answered prayer and abiding through obedience (3:19–22, 24); 3:23 is A012. Cf. A040 (5:14–15).

title: Whoever knows God listens to us: discern the spirit of truth
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: 4:6 closes the test begun in 4:1: 'By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.' Extend A061 to 4:1–6.

title: Whoever confesses the Son and abides in love abides in God
speaker: the writer of 1 John, on God's commandment
note: Extend A012's Additional Scripture 1 John 4:7–12 to 4:7–16: belief (4:15) and love (4:16), the record's two elements; AUD-66-4-17 starts at 4:17.

title: Loving God's children means loving God and keeping His commandments
speaker: the writer of 1 John, on God's commandment
note: 5:1–3 continue 4:21, an A012 link: extend it to 4:21–5:5. 5:3 also echoes K042 (John 14:15); faith overcomes the world (5:4–5).

title: Believe God's testimony: whoever has the Son has life
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: Doctrinal, but implies the call to believe in the Son God sent (K031, John 6:29). 5:6–8 and 5:13 need nothing.

title: Those born of God keep themselves; know the true God
speaker: the writer of 1 John
note: The closing 'we know' affirmations ground the final command; 5:20's 'true God' sets up 'guard yourselves from idols'. 5:18 restates 3:9.

title: Greet the friends by name
speaker: the elder
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-50-16-20 groups closing greeting instructions as parallels (it already links 1 Peter 5:14); 1:13–14 and the peace wish need nothing.

title: The ungodly intruders: waterless clouds, grumblers, flatterers, judged as Enoch foretold
speaker: Jude, citing Enoch's prophecy
recipient: those who are called, beloved in God
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: The woe of 1:11 continues with the intruders' portrait and Enoch's prophecy of judgment; extend A095 to 1:11–16 (AUD-69-1-17 resumes at 1:17).

title: Christ has John write to Ephesus, commending its testing of false apostles
speaker: the risen Christ
recipient: John, for the angel and church in Ephesus
note: Extend X009 (2:4–7) to the whole letter 2:1–7, with its 'write' order, as AUD-70-2-12 and AUD-70-2-18 cover theirs.

title: Christ has John write to Smyrna, knowing its affliction and poverty
speaker: the risen Christ
recipient: John, for the angel and church in Smyrna
note: Extend X010 (2:10–11) to the whole letter 2:8–11, including the order to write, as the Pergamum–Laodicea records do.

title: Christ has John write to Sardis, alive in name but dead
speaker: the risen Christ
recipient: John, for the angel and church in Sardis
note: Adds the 'write' order and the rebuke that grounds 3:2–3; with P03091 (3:4–6) X011 becomes the whole letter 3:1–6.

title: The undefiled few in Sardis will walk in white; hear the Spirit
speaker: the risen Christ
recipient: the angel and church in Sardis
note: The worthy few, the promise to the conqueror and the only unrecorded 'let him hear' refrain (3:6); X011 becomes 3:1–6 with P03090.

title: The trumpet-like voice summons John to come up and see
speaker: the first voice, like a trumpet (the risen Christ of 1:10)
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: 'Come up hither, and I will show thee…': a summons like AUD-70-11-11 ('Come up here'). 4:2–11 is vision and praise.

title: The living creatures call 'Come' as each of four horsemen rides out
speaker: the four living creatures
note: One record for the four calls (6:1, 3, 5, 7); AUD-70-6-5 holds only the oil-and-wine restraint. Covers P03096 (6:7–8).

title: Those who washed their robes serve before the throne and are shepherded
speaker: one of the elders
note: The elder's answer runs to 7:17; extend AUD-70-22-14's Additional Scripture link 7:13–14 to 7:13–17. Promise rather than direction.

title: The two witnesses' granted powers: fire, shutting heaven, plagues
speaker: the speaker who calls them My two witnesses
note: The authority granted in 11:3 is spelled out in 11:5–6; extend AUD-70-11-3 to 11:3–6. 11:7–10 narrate their death.

title: Babylon has fallen; whoever worships the beast drinks God's fury
speaker: the second and third angels
note: 14:9–12 (outside candidate list) is linked only to AUD-70-13-11, the beast's own decree; extend AUD-70-14-6 to the three angels' messages, 14:6–12.

title: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord
speaker: a voice from heaven, confirmed by the Spirit
recipient: John and the hearers of the prophecy
note: Outside candidate list. AUD-70-14-13 records only the order to write; its note separates the writing order from the beatitude's content.

title: A bowl angel summons John to see the great prostitute's judgment
speaker: one of the seven angels with the bowls
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: 'Come, I will show thee…'; 21:9 repeats the formula (P03122) and could be linked as Additional Scripture. 17:3–6 is vision.

title: The angel interprets the eighth king, ten horns, waters and woman
speaker: the angel explaining the vision
note: The explanation announced in 17:7 runs to 17:18; extend AUD-70-17-7 (17:7–10) to 17:7–18.

title: In one day her plagues will come, for her Judge is mighty
speaker: the voice from heaven
note: 'For this reason' completes the charge of 18:6–7; extend AUD-70-18-6 to 18:6–8. The laments (18:9–19) and millstone sign (18:21–24) need nothing.

title: The heavenly multitude and elders cry Hallelujah over Babylon's judgment
speaker: a great multitude in heaven, the elders and the living creatures
note: 'Hallelujah' (Praise the Lord) frames the call of 19:5; link 19:1–4 as Additional Scripture beside 19:6–8. Largely doxology, so low.

title: Blessed are those called to the Lamb's marriage supper
speaker: the angel speaking with John
recipient: John and the hearers of the prophecy
note: Outside candidate list. AUD-70-19-9 records the order to write; the beatitude itself, like 1:3 and 16:15, could be itemized as Wisdom.

title: Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection
speaker: John, the narrative voice of the revelation
note: Revelation's fifth beatitude has no record; origin follows the narrator's sayings AUD-70-13-9 and AUD-70-13-18. 20:4 'judgment was given' is narrative.

title: God gives the thirsty the water of life freely
speaker: the One sitting upon the throne
note: Same free offer of the water of life to the thirsty as 22:17; cf. John 7:37–39 (AUD-47-7-37).

title: The conqueror inherits; cowards, liars and idolaters face the second death
speaker: the One sitting upon the throne
recipient: John and the hearers of the prophecy
note: Same blessing-and-exclusion as 22:14–15, with a near-identical vice list, here in God's own words.

title: A bowl angel summons John to see the bride, the Lamb's wife
speaker: one of the seven angels with the bowls
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Same formula as 17:1 (new, P03114); one record with Additional Scripture would also suit. 21:10–26 describe the city.

title: Nothing common or false enters; only those in the Lamb's book
speaker: John, the narrative voice of the revelation
note: Same exclusion from the city as 22:15; descriptive, so low.

title: Christ comes quickly to repay each according to his work
speaker: the risen Christ
note: Christ's own words, grounding 22:11 and 22:14; same principle as 2:23 (in AUD-70-2-18). Could instead extend AUD-70-22-14.

summary: The letters mainly need paragraph records extended; Revelation lacks the 20:6 beatitude, John's summonses (4:1, 17:1, 21:9), the horsemen's 'Come', and whole-letter coverage for Ephesus, Smyrna and Sardis.
